Officer's narrative
Officers were dispatched to a side-impact collision at an intersection in Baytown, Texas. Driver 1 was operating the
vehicle that was struck on the passenger side by Driver 2, whose vehicle entered the intersection against the signal.
Driver 1 presented proof of insurance at the scene, and the policy listed Driver 1 as a named insured. Driver 1 was
seen seated in the driver's position, and Psasenger was also confirmed to be inside the vehicle at the time of impact.
Driver 1 reported a wrist inujry and was transported for treatment. Driver 2 stated that the vehicle entered the
intersection without stopping, and this account matched statements from two independent witnesses who saw the
collision. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the driver's side of Driver 2's vehicle and the passenger
side of Driver 1's vehicle, consistent with the angle and force of the impact. No prior damage to either vehicle was
observed or reported. Based on the evidence gathered, the collision occurred as described by the parties and
witnesses.
